themes.title: Abu Dhabi bets on OpenAI for a world-first AI-native government and energy
themes.summary: Abu Dhabi is converting sovereign capital into frontier-AI access: OpenAI will co-build the world's first AI-native government, while ADNOC and G42 move to deploy OpenAI models across energy operations. For GCC executives this shifts the region from buyer to partner in the frontier stack.
themes.angle: Sovereign AI goes from slogan to signed deal - watch execution risk, not announcements.

themes.title: AI keeps the datacenter silicon economy hot as geopolitics bites
themes.summary: Chip economics stay bid: AMD guided Q4 revenue to $17B, beating estimates, and Super Micro raised its outlook on AI server demand. Yet Nvidia is ordering cloud clients to cut China exposure and debt markets are repricing datacentre risk - the boom now carries a geopolitical and financing tax.
themes.angle: Demand is real; the question is who pays the margin and geopolitical premium.

themes.title: GCC AI and fintech ecosystem expands amid a global tech-spending wave
themes.summary: Dubai's DIFC has crossed 2,000 AI-fintech companies and opened its ecosystem to thousands of Japanese startups, while Saudi's MCIT relaunches its AI talent bridge. Regional AI infrastructure is scaling on the back of near-$5.6T global tech spending.
themes.angle: The talent-and-access arms race, not compute, is the GCC's real moat.

themes.angle: Regulation and national security, not benchmarks, now drive AI's political economy.
